name: Miss Bellevue Never Heard The Whistle
source:
Piper Lam (renameable) has always dreamed of being a journalist—being able to hone her fine storytelling skills and exposing secrets of the power brokers was all that motivated her. Such ambition brought her from San Francisco to the Atlantic Coast, only to find her assigned to the society columns. Opportunity presents itself in the most unusual of ways, though, such as a murder on the transnational express she's travelling on and an unexpected ally in a fellow passenger. 

[From [url=https://illegalileo.itch.io/bellevue]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
林派珀（已更名）一直梦想成为一名记者——能够磨练自己出色的讲故事技巧和揭露权力掮客的秘密是她的全部动力。这种野心将她从旧金山带到了大西洋海岸，却发现她被分配到社会专栏。然而，机会却以最不寻常的方式出现，比如她所乘坐的跨国快车上发生了一起谋杀案，以及一位同行乘客意外的盟友。

[来自[url=https://illegalileo.itch.io/bellevue]itch.io[/url]]
